description: The Bergen march's reported Palestine-support focus is foreign-directed, while its possible domestic target is an alleged restriction of the march by police/municipal authorities. The captured bodies do not establish that organizers made a specific demand of Norway's government or state policy.
required_followup: Find a contemporaneous organizer statement or independent report naming a Norwegian public authority and the demand directed to it; retain pending state-target status unless evidenced.

description: The only numeric Bergen crowd estimate (>300) is in movement-aligned Tjen Folket reporting. iNyheter confirms a march and police separation but supplies no headcount and is commentary by an MP.
required_followup: Seek an independent Bergen outlet or police report with a same-time count; do not inflate or combine counts from separate demonstrations.

description: Six captured Norwegian/English open-web queries surfaced October events but coverage is centered on Oslo/Bergen and does not establish a systematic sweep of all regions or protest sectors. Official historical baseline and source-ledger context are absent.
required_followup: If further research is scheduled, search regional Norwegian outlets and official police/local records by week and city, with exact-target assessments before any body access.
